title: Khu vực hành lý quá khổ ở đâu?
englishTitle: Where is the oversized baggage area?
pronunciation: Khu vuc hanh ly qua kho o dau
summary: For finding the side counter, belt, or doorway where large luggage comes out after a flight.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Ask before waiting at the normal carousel with a stroller, surfboard, box, golf bag, or bulky suitcase.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Keep the baggage tag and flight number visible. Airport staff can usually point to a side door, special belt, or service desk.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Khu vực means area; hành lý quá khổ means oversized baggage; ở đâu asks where.

breakdown.vietnamese: Khu vực hành lý quá khổ ở đâu?
breakdown.english: Where is the oversized baggage area?

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Immigration, domestic-terminal, and SIM-card cards help when the answer sends you back across the arrivals hall.

phrases.english: Where can I buy a SIM card?

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good in the arrivals hall, at baggage claim, or beside an airline counter when your item is too large for the regular belt.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Oversized items may arrive later than normal bags. Show the tag before explaining the item so staff can check the right flight.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Baggage-claim, pickup-area, driver-meet, missing-bag, and visa cards cover the next airport move.
